headline: United's hubs run normally; a ground delay program slows Seattle arrivals.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better.
The FAA has a ground delay program in effect for flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT. Those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 32 minutes and up to 82 minutes.
653 United flights, including United Express, are in the air, about the usual number for this time of day; the median at this hour over the past 7 days was 674.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
